note: Shared prompt fragments and the shared palette. The manifest refers to fragments by name; the full prompt is the subject followed by each fragment, joined with commas.

fragments.style: early-1990s VGA DOS dungeon crawler pixel art, 256-color palette, visible dithering, chunky hand-pixelled shading, torchlit, gritty and muted, not cute, not 16-bit console
fragments.sprite: single subject, front-facing, centered, full body, plain flat solid magenta background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no border
fragments.object: single object, front-facing, centered, whole object in frame, plain flat solid magenta background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no border
fragments.topdown: single object seen from directly above, centered, filling most of the frame, plain flat solid magenta background, no shadow, no text, no border
fragments.texture: flat, straight-on, evenly lit, edge to edge, no perspective, no objects
fragments.icon: a single game inventory icon of the object alone, centered, large in frame, plain flat solid magenta background, no shadow, no text, no border
fragments.neutral: made of pale off-white and light grey material with no strong colour, so it can be tinted
fragments.peaceful: standing upright and calm, hands visible and open, not threatening, warm pale colours
fragments.ui: a flat game interface piece seen straight-on, evenly lit, stone and dark iron, no text, no letters, no icons
fragments.portrait: head and shoulders portrait, facing the viewer, plain dark background, no text, no border
fragments.scene: wide establishing view, no text, no letters, no border
fragments.tile: one seamless square surface tile seen exactly straight on, orthographic, uniform brightness from edge to edge, no vignette, no dark corners, no room, no torches
fragments.surface: a flat patch of this surface seen exactly straight on, the same pattern continuing past every edge, orthographic, uniform brightness, no vignette, no border, no frame, no centre motif
fragments.nolights: no torches, no lanterns, no lamps, no flames, no glow, no light sources
fragments.edit: Same size and same place in the frame. No motion lines, no speed lines, no added effects, no text. Keep the flat background exactly as it is.
fragments.gap: Fill every opening with the same flat colour as the background.
fragments.music: instrumental, no vocals, loopable, early-1990s DOS game soundtrack, FM synth and sampled orchestra
fragments.sting: instrumental, no vocals, a single short piece with a clear ending, early-1990s DOS game soundtrack
fragments.sfx: one short clean sound effect, close and dry, no music, no voice-over
